label: Drag to Reorder
description: Sortable list with drag-and-drop reordering, built directly on pointer events — mouse, touch and pen all work. Ships a Drag To Reorder node: feed it an Items array and it renders the rows; while dragging, the other rows translate out of the way and a drop indicator marks the target slot. Dropping outputs Reordered Items (a new array — the input is never mutated), From Index and To Index, then fires a Changed signal. Row colours come from design tokens and are stylable per instance. No dependencies, no network.
